entries.title: Psalms 57:1
segments: The mercy of God forms the never-failing plea of his people; to him as a refuge they apply in every season of calamity, and patiently wait for his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 57:4
segments:
Lions; fierce and cruel men who sought to destroy him. 
 
  Set on fire; inflamed by their passions, and inflaming others. 
 
  Spears and arrows; instruments of destruction. 
 
However numerous the enemies, and however great the danger of God's people, he will protect them, and at length deliver them from all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 57:5
segments: Be thou exalted, O God; for the deliverance vouchsafed to me; which the psalmist here anticipates.

entries.title: Psalms 57:6
segments: The efforts of the wicked to destroy the righteous often prove the means of their own ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 57:7
segments: Fixed; settled on the foundation of the everlasting covenant; determined, in the strength and by the grace of God, to trust in and praise him.

entries.title: Psalms 57:8
segments: My glory; the same as, my soul, see note to

entries.title: Psalms 57:9
segments: The godly not only praise God themselves, but desire that he may be praised by all people throughout the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 57:10
segments: Great unto the heavens; immeasurably great.
